address: 5F, Mandarin Oriental Wangfujing, 269 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng, Beijing, China Mainland
bio: This stylish cafe tells a narrative that is less to do with pushing boundaries and more focused on celebrating traditions. Its concise menu stars all of Canton’s culinary hits – seafood, stir fries, soups… you name it! Each dish rustled up by the veteran kitchen team showcases their shrewd judgment. Also try the refreshing cocktails, interestingly infused with Chinese tea. The views of the Forbidden City from the roof-terrace are also a plus!...
